title: Thinkspace Action Master — demo walkthrough
scope: Action module only (sections A–F, partial G). Agenda (H) is a separate flow.

crudSummary.Create: Bucketlist → Specific quick-create modal → POST tasks/
crudSummary.Read: Today/Week list row click → GET tasks/:id/ detail modal
crudSummary.Update: Description, progress slider, post update → PATCH / set-task-progress / post-task-update
crudSummary.Delete: Detail modal Delete → POST delete-task/ (before Done — Done disables Delete)
